question.prompt: A school has 1200 students. A random sample of 50 students is tested, and 40 meet the standard. Estimate the number of students in the school who meet the standard.

solutions.explanation: The proportion meeting the standard in the sample is \(40/50=80\%\). The estimated number meeting the standard in the school is \(1200\times80\%=960\).
solutions.title: Apply the sample percentage
